QuestInfo.name: Eliminating Aliens
QuestInfo.0: I should go see Dr. Kim at the Command Center in the Omega Sector.
QuestInfo.1: Dr. Kim in the Omega Sector Command Center asked you to take care of #b#p2050001##k in Boswell Field. His new robot isn't finished yet, so it's up to you. Find the hiding place of #rMachine MT-09#k through the hidden entrance in #b#m221030600##k and eliminate #r5#k of them.
QuestInfo.2: I managed to eliminate all 5 MT-09's that Dr. Kim of the Command Center requested. I really hope that the new robot is made soon, so I don't have to ever do this again.

0.0: Hmmm... we have ourselves an emergency. We received a word that a group of imposing, threatening aliens are on their way here. The problem is, the new robot is still on its developmental stage... arrgh, this is driving me crazy! You... if that's fine with you, will you please help us out? We need your word right now.

yes.0: Thanks so much! One of the strongest weapons of the Mateons, #b#o5120100##k, is based out of a #bsecret area#k in #b#m221030600##k. That's WAY too close to Omega Sector for my tastes. Our forces are well trained, but they're just too much...
yes.1: Can you go handle #r5#k of those aliens? Remember, it's called #r#o5120100##k. Those things were made with the latest alien technology, so they're a force to be reckoned with! Now would be a great time to combine our forces, right? Oh, and #b#p2051001##k in #b#m221000200##k also has some business with #r#o5120100##k, so you should see what's up.

no.0: Really...! I thought you'd be there to help us out. This is quite disappointing. I'll have to find someone else eager to join forces with us. Now, if you'll excuse me...

1.0: Oh my goodness... did you really find a way to defeat #b5 #o5120100#s#k? I knew you were something else, but this just blows my mind! Alright... since you helped us protect the Omega Sector as well as Ludibrium, I'll have to reward you accordingly. This will definitely help you on your journey, so please take it.

yes.0: You got the hat I gave you? On behalf of Omega Sector, I thank you for all your help. Good thing we met you when we did. Now, we've got to work on developing some new robots... Come visit us from time to time.

mob.0: I don't think you have completed my task, yet. Head over to the hidden area of Boswell Field defeat #b5 #o5120100#s#k for us.
